| `C1-TASK-10` | reverse/backend change lowers the representation ceiling after TaskDone | backend dependency stales the current head before false; `invalidate-task-attestation` |
| `C1-TASK-11` | selected task head is marked current but promotion proof or exact environment/grant/calibration/bound-receipt binding is null/divergent | integrity conflict; no TaskDone read/projection/dependency/feedback; `fail-closed` |
| `C1-TASK-12` | descendant transition slice gaps/reorders/crosses ref, ancestry receipt is opaque/negative, or history-rewrite authorization differs from settlement authority | task lineage `oneOf`/member/root/receipt equality rejects before verifier GO or attestation |
| `C1-TASK-13` | task A origin saga settles, task B advances the same protected ref before A opens its first terminal draft, or caller substitutes a later task as A's origin | `direct-descendant-current-task` binds A's exact origin plus the complete normal settlement slice/current tip and positive ancestry receipt; substitution, gap or rewrite rejects before verifier GO, while the legitimate race remains completable |
| `C1-GOAL-00` | open completion draft before attestation transaction | exact generated goal head, signed snapshot-backed baseline, fully settled final saga/released fence/broker-retirement closure, continuous member root and slots are re-evaluated; `evaluate-goal-completion` |
| `C1-GOAL-00B` | draft consume/attestation/head transaction committed before caller ack | exact consumed draft, superseded predecessor and sole attestation head persist; `noop` |
| `C1-GOAL-01` | final ref/commit/tree changes, including same-tree commit replacement | completion becomes stale; `invalidate-goal-attestation` |
| `C1-GOAL-02` | config changes after effect arm/before ack | apply/observer rejects identity; `invalidate-goal-attestation` |
| `C1-GOAL-03` | use T1 receipt/waiver envelopes to construct a new T2 draft/attestation, including same-tree different-commit T2 | draft/input-hash mismatch rejects every substituted envelope; `fail-closed` |
| `C1-GOAL-04` | concurrent runs/drafts race to create or promote completion for one stable goal-lineage/ref | run is not a head-key dimension; one expected goal-head revision CAS wins and losers create no attestation/projection; `fail-closed` |
| `C1-GOAL-05` | ref moves A→B→A while a goal draft/head exists | ref-generation/anchor change stales the draft/head despite matching final OID; `invalidate-goal-attestation` |
| `C1-GOAL-06` | only origin run changes for the same goal-lineage/contract/ref/input | run is excluded from head/input uniqueness; existing draft/attestation or the same head CAS returns with zero new verifier GO |
| `C1-GOAL-07` | a contract revision attempts to insert a parallel goal head | stable lineage/contract/ref key rejects; revision must invalidate/supersede/CAS the existing head |
| `C1-GOAL-08` | caller renames goal lineage/contract to evade a negative or current head | absent exact externally approved lineage-origin fork object, contract/head creation rejects |
| `C1-GOAL-09` | run ID is included in head key or goal completion-input hash by an implementation | schema/hash corpus rejects the record before authority mutation |
| `C1-GOAL-10` | final ref is only kernel-bound/settlement-committed, writer fence is unreleased, broker retirement closure is absent, or final settlement/member root is incomplete | no goal draft/verifier GO/attestation/GoalComplete; exact Git fence/settlement recovery finishes first; `fail-closed` |
| `C1-GOAL-11` | goal-contract approval omits/substitutes its baseline, samples a non-current/rewrite-pending/unsettled head snapshot, or reuses a predecessor/run baseline implicitly | approval subject/snapshot/source/predecessor oneOf rejects; no approved revision, draft or verifier GO |
| `C1-GOAL-12` | baseline→final settlement slice starts late, has a cross-project/ref row, gap/duplicate/reorder, wrong ordinal/count/generation/anchor, or rewrite resets baseline | member/root/property recomputation rejects before verifier allocation or attestation; `fail-closed` |
| `C1-GOAL-13` | baseline/head-snapshot + contract approval insert/nonce consume commits before acknowledgment or only a subset appears | one transaction returns the same approved contract/baseline/snapshot/approval tuple, or none; no resampling |
| `C1-GOAL-14` | caller supplies a different expected/attested goal-head hash while registry/project/checkout/lineage/contract/ref are unchanged | generated head-key/FK equality rejects; no parallel draft/head/attestation |

| `C1-REVOKE-01` | active or archived receipt/waiver revoked | dependent proof/attestation stale in same transaction; `invalidate-proof-dependencies` |
| `C2-GOAL-PROMOTE-01` | provisional attestation before promotion, including missing grant/calibration/bound receipt that later becomes current | `canCountGoalCompletion` remains false; exact goal/capability dependencies are re-evaluated and only `evaluate-goal-promotion` may CAS current |
| `C2-GOAL-PROMOTE-02` | provisional-to-current promotion committed before caller ack | exact current attestation/GoalComplete projection persists; `noop` |

| `C2-CAL-01` | required calibration revoked | current completion becomes stale; `invalidate-proof-dependencies` |
| `C2-CAL-02` | missing/not-current/unsupported calibration or wrong execution-cell default grant | provisional state cannot promote and trusted terminal reads false; `fail-closed` |
| `C2-CAL-03` | candidate-execution token is replayed or presented to approval, Git-ref, terminal or feedback method | audience/method capability rejection; no trusted mutation; `fail-closed` |
| `C2-CALRUN-00` | `prepared`, including clean-before result captured before phase CAS | exact preallocated attempt resumes/settles once; `resume-calibration-clean-before` |
| `C2-CALRUN-01` | `clean-passed`, including known-bad result captured before phase CAS | exact mutation attempt resumes/settles once; `resume-calibration-known-bad` |
| `C2-CALRUN-02` | `mutation-rejected`, including clean-replay result captured before phase CAS | exact replay attempt resumes/settles once; `resume-calibration-clean-replay` |
| `C2-CALRUN-03` | `replay-passed` before current-calibration transaction | ordered three-receipt set is revalidated atomically; `finalize-calibration-current` |
| `C2-CALRUN-04` | `current` transaction committed before caller ack | exactly one current calibration fact; `noop` |
| `C2-CALRUN-05` | receipt from another run/candidate/environment is offered to any phase | run enters manual-conflict and cannot calibrate; `diagnose-only` |
| `B2A-FEEDBACK-01` | concurrent opposite outcomes in one group | zero weight/manual conflict; `reconcile-feedback-conflict` |
| `B2A-FEEDBACK-02` | one tree/change split across criteria | one evaluation cluster/cohort weight; `noop` |
| `B1-SELECT-01` | `asOf` lacks its trusted clock observation, regresses its trusted floor, or learned time is later than it | no selection snapshot/dispatch binding; evidence risk; `fail-closed` |
| `B1-SELECT-02` | candidate/catalog/conflict members are permuted, including an unresolved equal-precedence cluster | canonical members/dispositions/reasons/snapshot bytes are identical; all unresolved members are suppressed; invariant |
| `B1-SELECT-03` | duplicate version IDs, multiple current versions for one semantic ID, or pre-resolution cap accounting changes membership | input/snapshot predicate rejects; no member consumes capacity and no dispatch binds; `fail-closed` |
| `B1-SELECT-04` | decay kind is unsupported, half-life non-positive, confidence/time non-finite, or floating-point behavior changes a threshold | no snapshot; fixed-point oracle mismatch blocks B1; `fail-closed` |
| `B2B-LIFECYCLE-01` | unique `prepared` decision commits before ack, or evaluation finishes before phase CAS | same owner/frozen input resumes deterministic evaluation once; no constraint version exists; `evaluate-constraint-lifecycle-decision` |
| `B2B-LIFECYCLE-02` | evaluated decision loses catalog/source, feedback, receipt, calibration, revocation, archive, policy or cell equality before apply | old owner becomes invalidated; no version; changed input receives a new owner; `classify-constraint-lifecycle-application` |
| `B2B-LIFECYCLE-03` | binders race, bind ack is lost, or required approval/input is revoked immediately before CAS | exactly one version/edge/receipt/catalog revision binds, or zero-result invalidation; `bind-constraint-lifecycle-version` |
| `B2B-LIFECYCLE-04` | capability skip receipt is missing/forged/wrong-cell-policy-platform, or result fields are non-null | phase/signature/capability predicate rejects; it cannot close the track as success; `fail-closed` |
| `B2B-LIFECYCLE-05` | decision is `approval-pending` and hard-promotion/override approval is missing, wrong-purpose/audience/object/signing-operation, stale or revoked | no `apply-prepared`/version; only exact current approval advances; `reconcile-constraint-lifecycle-approval` |
| `B2B-LIFECYCLE-06` | archive restore/replay uses the same equivalence key with divergent target/result bytes | original aggregate/version remains authoritative; divergent replay writes nothing; exact replay returns it; `fail-closed` |
| `D2-CELL-01` | attempt to use qualification/soak/default grant from another Node/ABI/durability class or probe/release/backend/supervisor cell or audience scope | no full-trusted capability; `fail-closed` |
| `D2-CELL-02` | current backend qualification/default grant expires or is revoked after TaskDone/GoalComplete | revocation invalidates dependents in its write; expiry is recorded stale by the first canonical read before false is returned; `invalidate-proof-dependencies` |
| `D2-CELL-03` | kernel/filesystem/mount/container identity drifts outside the approved class or invalidates its probe observation | current environment observation is invalidated and production becomes read-only until requalified; `fail-closed` |

Every manifest row additionally freezes injection hook, authority/epoch/route
hashes, required receipt fields and one closed verdict. Every `recovery` row must
name exactly one action from `recovery-action.schema.json`; `denial|invariant`
rows cannot smuggle in a recovery choice. Row-count or hash drift fails
`check:state-architecture`.

## 9. Quantified verification and SLO

PR stress has a 15-minute CI wall-clock budget and a deterministic scaled fault
subset. Nightly deterministic stress simulates 72 hours with at least 50,000
kernel transactions, 10,000 selections, 1,000 receipt attempts, eight concurrent
writers, fixed load rates, clock skew, and seeded faults at every documented boundary. It requires
zero ambiguous authority, zero duplicate feedback, stale-token rejection, and a
drained/non-silent outbox.

Nightly soak runs at least eight real hours with three concurrent managers and a
process kill at least every 15 minutes. Release-candidate qualification runs 72
real hours. Required SLOs:

Multi-hour soaks do not rely on a GitHub-hosted job exceeding its runtime limit.
PR jobs run only the scaled subset; nightly/release workflows submit a signed
manifest to a dedicated qualified self-hosted runner/service, persist raw
observations in the external control store, and poll the content-addressed
result in restartable short jobs. Runner restart is itself a censored failure
unless the same externally identified soak resumes with continuous operation
ledger and fault schedule; concatenating unrelated green chunks cannot satisfy
an eight/72-hour claim.
Unavailable or unqualified runner/service yields `soak-unavailable`; it blocks
the corresponding nightly/release claim and per-cell default grant rather than
downgrading to concatenated hosted-CI evidence.

- no false Done/approved commit and no unresolved mixed authority;
- deterministic qualification collects at least 1,000 recovery samples and
  requires empirical p99 under 5 seconds; timeout/censored samples count as
  failures. Eight-hour soak reports max/p50 with at least 32 scheduled kills.
  The 72-hour release soak schedules enough kills for at least 1,000 samples
  before making a p99 claim, with p99 under 30 seconds;
- every automatically repairable required outbox effect reaches done or a typed
  `dead_letter_resolved` outcome within 60 seconds after both the cause clears
  and its valid repair disposition/precondition are available. Unsafe or
  nonretryable uncertainty remains an unresolved blocker/censored SLO failure;
  release required-effect unresolved dead-letter budget is zero, and a cancelled
  dependency never counts as effect success;
- WAL stays under 64 MiB after checkpoint policy; active DB under 512 MiB for the
  declared workload; archive/receipt growth matches the retention budget;
- all reports are machine-readable and bind source/config/backend plus the exact
  Node major/ABI, durability class/probe, observed kernel/filesystem/mount,
  backend-package and supervisor execution-cell hash.

The workload/fault manifest and correctness oracle run outside the candidate
under the pinned qualification supervisor. They define load rate, random seed,
fault schedule, recovery start/end, minimum sample count, censored-failure
treatment, criterion oracle, and ambiguity checks. The report binds that
manifest, oracle/supervisor hashes, exact execution-cell hash, receipt head, and raw observations;
candidate-generated summary text cannot activate a default grant.

The oracle maintains its own monotonic operation ledger and expected state
machine. It compares protected read-only DB snapshots, Git refs/trees, OS process
death, outbox facts and projection manifests rather than trusting candidate API
or report fields. Default activation is an append-only capability grant written
by the previous trusted supervisor for exactly one
execution-cell/release-artifact/backend-package/supervisor/fault-manifest tuple. A report or
grant from another Node major/ABI, durability class/probe or binary hash never
authorizes the current cell. Every release-supported cell must either run its
own required fault/soak workload or remain provisional; a PR subset cannot
activate the rest of the matrix. Insufficient samples yield
`qualification-incomplete`.

Verification covers migration corruption, already-migrated/replay/rollback,
legacy trust quarantine, time skew, lease steal, projection generation failure,
intent duplicates/reordering, constraint revocation and replay, receipt archive
restore, bootstrap local-activate/external-bind/repair windows, governed Git
`prepare` orphan-lock recovery, mutation isolation, gate self-modification, and
old writer attempts.

Release requires `npm run check:all`, `npm run check:coverage`,
`npm run check:e2e`, `npm run validate:distribution`, DocStore doctor, platform
qualification receipts, soak report, and final fresh-context review.

## 10. Stop conditions

Return to planning when:

- no SQLite implementation meets the declared Node/OS/install/durability matrix;
- BTS-0, its registry seal-key provider, stable root/lock or admitted bootstrap
  review root is compromised, unavailable or needs byte replacement; live BTS/
  root handoff is outside vNext and requires offline rebootstrap while trust-
  control mutation remains read-only;
- the reviewed bootstrap staging sandbox/oracle cannot independently isolate and
  judge an inactive target before A1/C0 installation;
- any bootstrap-backed target consumer cannot verify the exact final external
  bound receipt/sealed anchor, or target repair lacks a unique fenced phase and
  deterministic cross-boundary recovery action;
- the current execution cell lacks an exact qualification/default grant or a
  backend transition can retain a stronger capability than its selected backend;
- state-domain inventory or architecture lint is incomplete;
- maintenance cannot prove quiescence or fence pre-cutover writers;
- rollback cannot represent all data before irreversible finalization;
- constraint conflicts require unstated semantic guesses;
- feedback is not reconstructible from immutable receipt-bound facts;
- any control-bundle component, review parser/profile/validator, provider adapter,
  qualification/target launcher, control coordinator or disposable executor is
  candidate-controlled, absent from its exact reviewed closure or lacks required
  exact-scope/two-key authorization;
- a round-ten implementation decision is used to execute TCB/target code in a
  staging/control context or count development output as authority, a
  bootstrap-TCB staging decision is used to install/activate, or the final A0
  object lacks its own exact `a0-merge-install` decision;
- reviewed validator/control-coordinator/executor or any target-bundle source is not the executed
  source-as-artifact or lacks two-build reproducibility and a complete runtime
  closure; the exact A0/successor trust-control artifact lacks a fresh detached
  external code-review PASS; bundle activation lacks a resumable fenced
  qualified disposable-executor install/repair saga, complete audit/reap and
  atomic final seal in the sole-writer BTS registry; or
  independent auditors/human raw-findings signature are absent;
- fewer than four formal review model classes across two provider trust domains
  satisfy the materialized wire/identity protocol, or any bootstrap ceremony was
  captured by an unadmitted review root;
- a candidate manager/router/CLI/worker/gate can access control state, approval
  credentials, privileged endpoint/secret/capability, Git common-dir writes or
  supervisor channels;
- a governed Git ref backend cannot provide the qualified external guardian
  owner, exact orphan-lock ownership/content proof, pre-effect reflog intents,
  same-device hardlink/rename/fsync/file-identity semantics, stable exclusion of
  every in-scope native index writer, or recoverable ref/tree/worktree/index-
  witness publication required for safe recovery;
- trusted Git hook execution lacks the exact four-kind program, preallocated
  RouteSpawn member attempts, reinstall/qualification disposition or complete
  reap/audit receipts;
- task completion lacks an exact-tip draft/input hash, one CAS-protected current
  lineage head, a fully settled/released-fence settlement composite or the
  mode-appropriate complete task transition root;
- goal completion lacks its own CAS-protected head and a draft/attestation bound
  to that same continuous protected Git ref generation, the approved
  `GoalGitBaselineV1`, exact final fully-settled/released-fence
  `GitSagaSettlementV1` composite ID/hash and complete continuous settlement-
  member root;
- work/receipts/approval are not bound to a current GoalAcceptanceContract and
  complete criterion coverage;
- a platform cannot enforce the claimed calibration sandbox;
- any required gate lacks valid proof or any CRITICAL/P1 remains.
